about.what: Test questions for the Ask page. For each question, `expect` lists the PSI investigations whose record or listed papers answer it. A result counts as a hit when it comes from one of them.
about.labelled_by: Claude (Anthropic), from the PSI records. To be checked by a team member.
about.note: Written before any ranking setting was changed. `everyday` marks questions phrased in words NASA's text does not use; they test the glossary.

split.method: mulberry32 shuffle of the everyday-word questions, then of the others, dealt alternately to the tuning and the held-out half
